derivation:
by
  apply Complex.ofReal_injective
  simpa [dens, UpperHalfPlane.petersson, UpperHalfPlane.σ, hβ, abs_of_pos hβ, Complex.conj_mul'] using (UpperHalfPlane.petersson_slash k F F β x)
explanation: Specialize the two functions in petersson_slash to F. Positive determinant removes the absolute value and makes σ the identity; the self-pairing is the complex coercion of dens.
